title: Musnad Ahmad ibn Hanbal
author: ibn-hanbal
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Ahmad ibn Hanbal's large collection of prophetic reports, arranged by the Companion who transmitted them rather than by legal topic. It preserves many reports not found in the six canonical collections and is a major source for early hadith criticism.
historicalContext: Compiled in Baghdad over decades and transmitted by Ahmad's son Abd Allah and later students. Its arrangement by isnad made it a working archive for the study of transmitters.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
